result.summary: The page looks generally well-structured and polished. A few content-level issues stand out: an implausible discount badge and a truncated restaurant name in the horizontal carousel.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card shows a '−100%' discount badge, implying the food is completely free. This is likely a pricing/data error that could confuse users or violate promotion rules.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount value in the data feed and correct it (e.g., −10% or −50%), or hide the badge if no valid promotion exists.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel appears truncated mid-word because the card overflows the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card widths allow full names with ellipsis truncation, or keep enough of the next card visible with proper text wrapping.

issues.description: The partially visible carousel card at the right edge is cut off abruptly with no fade or peek affordance, making it unclear more content is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle edge fade or partially visible next card to signal horizontal scrolling.
